payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate downwards from y to p+1, test each i for divisibility by any integer ≤p using an optimized primality check, stop at first i with no such divisor.
payload.rationale: The algorithm is a linear search with early exit, not true branch-and-bound. Among given subtypes, it fits best because termination upon finding a solution resembles pruning, while backtracking, bitmask, DFS/BFS, permutation are inapplicable.
